text.traceableprint.config.missing_depen: Cloth Config is required to open this config screen. Install it and try again.
text.traceableprint.title: Traceable Print Settings
text.traceableprint.option.spawnInterval: Ticks between movement checks that may drop a new footprint.
text.traceableprint.option.minDistance.@: Minimum distance, in blocks, between two consecutive footprints. Closer steps are skipped.
text.traceableprint.option.printsForInvi: Whether entities under invisibility (effect or invisible flag) still leave footprints. Sneaking always suppresses prints regardless of this setting.
text.traceableprint.option.textureSize.@: Base size of a footprint in blocks (square side length). The per-mob size list multiplies on top of this.
text.traceableprint.appearance.header: The settings below apply locally only and are not affected by the server.
text.traceableprint.option.yOffset.@Tool: Unit: blocks. Does not affect the hitbox height.
Notifies a player when someone else highlights them by tracing along their footprints.
text.traceableprint.option.directionPart: Whether a highlighted footprint entity emits particles toward its target.
Footprints only appear where the block's hardness is below this value. Blocks in the 'Block Whitelist' bypass this check.
text.traceableprint.option.applyBlocks.@: Blocks that always allow footprints regardless of the hardness gate: write namespace:path, or #namespace:tag for a tag.
text.traceableprint.option.entityListInv: Off: the entity list is a blacklist - listed mobs leave no footprints. On: it becomes a whitelist - only listed mobs leave footprints.
text.traceableprint.option.entityList.@T: Entity IDs as namespace:path, or #namespace:tag for a whole tag. Acts as a blacklist or a whitelist depending on 'Invert Entity List'.
text.traceableprint.per_mob.header: Each entry is 'namespace:name,value'. Mobs do not support tags. Changes here do not affect footprints that have already spawned.
text.traceableprint.option.sizeList.@Too: Scale the footprint for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.sideOffsetLis: Set the left/right offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.forwardOffset: Set the front/back offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.blockHeightLi: Apply an extra height offset to footprints on specific blocks. Not controlled by the server.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.format: Format: 'modid:mobid,textureName1,textureName2,...' - the text before the first comma is the entity's registry name; everything after it is a pool of candidate texture names, and one is picked at random each time a footprint spawns.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.path: A bare name (no colon) resolves to traceableprint:textures/entity/<name>.png. Write a full 'namespace:path' to load art from another mod's or your own resource-pack namespace. The '.png' suffix is optional and matching is case-insensitive.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.match: Only exact 'namespace:path' matches apply here; tags (#namespace:tag) are not supported. If nothing matches, the default footprint.png is used and a warning is logged.
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_id: The id (before the first comma) is empty.
text.traceableprint.row_error.invalid_id: Invalid id. Use 'namespace:path', or '#namespace:tag' for a tag.
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_valu: The value (after the comma) is empty.
text.traceableprint.row_error.invalid_fl: The value is not a valid number.
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_cand: No texture name given after the id.
text.traceableprint.row_error.duplicate_: Duplicate id - each id may appear only once; merge these entries.
